snippet.title: Blaster Master Zero 2 - Kanna Raising Simulator DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Okay everyone, nice and loud now! Ready?!

Raise your own Kanna in this totally bonkers mini-game coming to Blaster Master Zero 2 on June 29, 2020!
